risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and quantifies assets, deposits, loan balances, PPP activity, deferrals, lending authorities, and net interest margin trends. Key risks include COVID-19-related borrower stress, credit deterioration, interest-rate repricing, funding dependence on deposits and Federal Home Loan Bank borrowings, and declining margins. The tone is operationally confident but acknowledges meaningful downside sensitivity and uses some broad, non-quantified risk language.
